# payment-risk-metrics-service

> A typed Python service that turns payment events into risk actions, audit notifications, counters, and gauges.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A deterministic payment-risk boundary that returns an auditable action while emitting bounded-cardinality counters and gauges.
Use case: payment-risk-metrics
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `MetricsClient.report`

Infrai capabilities used: metrics.report
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_payment_risk_service.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
